description.value:
Frequency once per round

Your keen senses and clever intellect help you maintain a constant and instinctive conversation with the narrative of existence, giving you uncanny knowledge of your surroundings and circumstances. You attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge]. If you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
